                            this.driftVelocity.x = Math.max(-1.7, 
Math.min(1.7, this.driftVelocity.x));
                            this.driftVelocity.y = Math.max(-1.7, 
Math.min(1.7, this.driftVelocity.y));
                        }
                        vx = this.driftVelocity.x;
                        vy = this.driftVelocity.y;
                }

                this.pos.x += vx * dt * speedMult;
                this.pos.y += vy * dt * speedMult;
            }

            getCorePosition() {
                const orbitX = Math.sin(this.corePhase * 1.7) * (this.w / 2 - 
25);
                const orbitY = Math.cos(this.corePhase * 1.3) * (this.h / 2 - 
25);
                return {
                    x: this.pos.x + this.w / 2 + orbitX,
                    y: this.pos.y + this.h / 2 + this.floatOffset + orbitY
                };
            }

            respawn() {
                const game = window.game;
                const padding = 80;
                const minX = padding;
                const maxX = game.width - padding - this.w;
                const minY = padding;
                const maxY = game.height - padding - this.h;

                let attempts = 0;
                let validPosition = false;

                while (!validPosition && attempts < 20) {
                    this.pos.x = minX + Math.random() * (maxX - minX);
                    this.pos.y = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);

                    const playerPaddle = game.player;
                    const aiPaddle = game.aiPaddle;

                    const playerDist = Math.hypot(
                        this.pos.x + this.w / 2 - (playerPaddle.pos.x + 
playerPaddle.w / 2),
                        this.pos.y + this.h / 2 - (playerPaddle.pos.y + 
playerPaddle.h / 2)
                    );

                    const aiDist = Math.hypot(
                        this.pos.x + this.w / 2 - (aiPaddle.pos.x + aiPaddle.w 
/ 2),
                        this.pos.y + this.h / 2 - (aiPaddle.pos.y + aiPaddle.h 
/ 2)
                    );

                    let tooCloseToOther = false;
                    for (const other of game.obstacles) {
                        if (other !== this && other.active) {
                            const dist = Math.hypot(
                                this.pos.x + this.w / 2 - (other.pos.x + 
other.w / 2),
                                this.pos.y + this.h / 2 - (other.pos.y + 
other.h / 2)
                            );
                            if (dist < 80) {
                                tooCloseToOther = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (playerDist > 100 && aiDist > 100 && !tooCloseToOther) {
                        validPosition = true;
                    }
                    attempts++;
                }

                this.active = true;
                this.hitParticles = [];
                this.coreTrails = [];
                this.bloomLayers = [];
                this.floatPhase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                this.corePhase = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                this.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                this.colorHue = (this.pos.x + this.pos.y * 37) % 360;
                this.patternType = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5);
                this.detailVariant = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);

                // Reset movement pattern
                this.pattern = this.choosePattern();
                this.patternTimer = 0;
                this.patternDuration = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
                this.initPattern();

                this.generateSurfaceDetails();
                this.updateColors();
            }

            getCollisionNormal(ball) {
                const closestX = Math.max(this.pos.x, Math.min(ball.pos.x, 
this.pos.x + this.w));
                const closestY = Math.max(this.pos.y, Math.min(ball.pos.y, 
this.pos.y + this.h));
                const normal = new Vec2(ball.pos.x - closestX, ball.pos.y - 
closestY);
                normal.normalize();
                return normal;
            }

            checkCollision(ball) {
                if (!this.active) return false;

                const closestX = Math.max(this.pos.x, Math.min(ball.pos.x, 
this.pos.x + this.w));
                const closestY = Math.max(this.pos.y, Math.min(ball.pos.y, 
this.pos.y + this.h));
                const distX = ball.pos.x - closestX;
                const distY = ball.pos.y - closestY;
                const distSq = distX * distX + distY * distY;

                if (distSq <= ball.r * ball.r) {
                    this.showShieldBurst = true;
                    this.shieldBurstTime = 0.5;
                    this.shieldBurstRadius = 0;
                    this.hitFlash = 1;

                    this.active = false;
                    this.respawnTimer = this.respawnDelay;

                    const impactNormal = this.getCollisionNormal(ball);

                    if (areParticleEffectsEnabled()) {
                        for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                            const angle = Math.atan2(impactNormal.y, 
impactNormal.x) +
                                (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.PI;
                            const speed = 120 + Math.random() * 180;

                            this.hitParticles.push(new Particle(
                                closestX, closestY,
                                this.highlightColor,
                                5 + Math.random() * 6,
                                0.9 + Math.random() * 0.6,
                                angle,
                                speed
                            ));
                        }

                        for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                            const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                            const speed = 60 + Math.random() * 120;

                            this.hitParticles.push(new Particle(
                                closestX, closestY,
                                this.primaryColor,
                                3 + Math.random() * 4,
                                0.7 + Math.random() * 0.5,
                                angle,
                                speed
                            ));
                        }
                    }

                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            }

            updateParticles(dt) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) {
                    this.hitParticles.length = 0;
                    return;
                }
                let writeIndex = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < this.hitParticles.length; i++) {
                    const particle = this.hitParticles[i];
                    if (particle.update(dt)) {
                        this.hitParticles[writeIndex++] = particle;
                    }
                }
                this.hitParticles.length = writeIndex;
            }

            generateSurfaceDetails() {
                const inset = 6;
                const innerW = Math.max(16, this.w - inset * 2);
                const innerH = Math.max(16, this.h - inset * 2);

                this.surfacePanels = [
                    { x: inset, y: inset, w: innerW, h: innerH, alpha: 0.12 },
                    { x: inset + 5, y: inset + 8, w: Math.max(16, innerW * 
0.52), h: Math.max(10, innerH * 0.18), alpha: 0.18 },
                    { x: inset + innerW * 0.18, y: inset + innerH * 0.48, w: 
Math.max(18, innerW * 0.64), h: Math.max(8, innerH * 0.14), alpha: 0.14 }
                ];

                this.rivetPoints = [
                    { x: 8, y: 8 },
                    { x: this.w - 8, y: 8 },
                    { x: 8, y: this.h - 8 },
                    { x: this.w - 8, y: this.h - 8 },
                    { x: this.w * 0.5, y: 8 },
                    { x: this.w * 0.5, y: this.h - 8 }
                ];

                const scanLineCount = Math.max(5, Math.floor(this.h / 7));
                this.scanLineOffsets = Array.from({ length: scanLineCount }, 
(_, i) => {
                    const ratio = scanLineCount === 1 ? 0.5 : i / 
(scanLineCount - 1);
                    return 6 + ratio * (this.h - 12);
                });

                this.hazardBands = [];
                if (this.detailVariant !== 1) {
                    const bandCount = 4;
                    for (let i = 0; i < bandCount; i++) {
                        this.hazardBands.push({
                            offset: -innerH * 0.25 + i * 18,
                            width: 10 + (i % 2) * 2
                        });
                    }
                }

                const nodeCount = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
                this.circuitNodes = Array.from({ length: nodeCount }, () => ({
                    x: 12 + Math.random() * Math.max(1, this.w - 24),
                    y: 12 + Math.random() * Math.max(1, this.h - 24)
                }));

                this.circuitLinks = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < this.circuitNodes.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < this.circuitNodes.length; j++) {
                        const dx = this.circuitNodes[i].x - 
this.circuitNodes[j].x;
                        const dy = this.circuitNodes[i].y - 
this.circuitNodes[j].y;
                        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                        if (dist < Math.min(this.w, this.h) * 0.9 && 
Math.random() > 0.35) {
                            this.circuitLinks.push([i, j]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            updateColors() {
                this.primaryColor = `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, ${this.lightness}%)`;
                this.secondaryColor = `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, ${Math.max(20, this.lightness * 0.85)}%)`;
                this.highlightColor = `hsl(${this.colorHue}, ${this.saturation 
* 0.8}%, ${Math.min(95, this.lightness * 1.15)}%)`;

                this.glowColor = `hsla(${this.colorHue}, ${this.saturation}%, 
${this.lightness * 1.2}%, 0.5)`;
                this.deepGlowColor = `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, ${this.lightness * 1.3}%, 0.2)`;

                this.edgeGlowTop = `hsla(${(this.colorHue + 15) % 360}, 
${this.saturation * 0.9}%, 85%, 0.6)`;
                this.edgeGlowBottom = `hsla(${(this.colorHue - 15 + 360) % 
360}, ${this.saturation * 0.8}%, 65%, 0.3)`;
            }

            render(ctx) {
                this.updateParticles(1 / 60);
                const particleEffectsEnabled = areParticleEffectsEnabled();

                if (!this.active) {
                    if (particleEffectsEnabled) {
                        this.hitParticles.forEach(p => p.render(ctx));
                    }
                    return;
                }

                ctx.save();

                const centerX = this.pos.x + this.w / 2;
                const centerY = this.pos.y + this.h / 2 + this.floatOffset;

                ctx.translate(centerX, centerY);
                ctx.rotate(this.rotation);
                ctx.translate(-centerX, -centerY);

                // ROCKET BOOSTER TRAIL – simple gradient slice behind obstacle
                {
                    const bodyX = this.pos.x;
                    const bodyY = this.pos.y + this.floatOffset;
                    const boostLen = 24 + Math.sin(this.pulsePhase * 2) * 6;
                    const tailX = bodyX + this.w * 0.5;
                    const tailY = bodyY + this.h;

                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(tailX, tailY, tailX, 
tailY + boostLen);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, this.highlightColor);
                    grad.addColorStop(0.5, this.highlightColor.replace('0.5', 
'0.0'));
                    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(tailX - this.w * 0.3, tailY);
                    ctx.lineTo(tailX + this.w * 0.3, tailY);
                    ctx.lineTo(tailX + this.w * 0.1, tailY + boostLen);
                    ctx.lineTo(tailX - this.w * 0.1, tailY + boostLen);
                    ctx.closePath();
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                // LAYER 1: Deep ambient glow (far bloom)
                const deepGlowRadius = Math.max(this.w, this.h) + 80;
                const deepGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    centerX, centerY, 0,
                    centerX, centerY, deepGlowRadius
                );
                deepGlow.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 90%, 0.15)`);
                deepGlow.addColorStop(0.6, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 70%, 0.05)`);
                deepGlow.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 60%, 0)`);

                ctx.fillStyle = deepGlow;
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, deepGlowRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // LAYER 2: Main glow halo
                const mainGlowRadius = Math.max(this.w, this.h) + 40;
                const mainGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    centerX, centerY, 0,
                    centerX, centerY, mainGlowRadius
                );
                const pulse = Math.sin(this.pulsePhase) * 0.1 + 0.9;
                mainGlow.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 95%, ${0.3 * pulse})`);
                mainGlow.addColorStop(0.3, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 85%, ${0.2 * pulse})`);
                mainGlow.addColorStop(0.7, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 75%, ${0.1 * pulse})`);
                mainGlow.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 65%, 0)`);

                ctx.fillStyle = mainGlow;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, mainGlowRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // LAYER 3: Soft inner glow (behind obstacle)
                const innerGlowRadius = Math.max(this.w, this.h) * 0.8;
                const innerGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    centerX, centerY, 0,
                    centerX, centerY, innerGlowRadius
                );
                innerGlow.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 100%, 0.4)`);
                innerGlow.addColorStop(0.5, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 90%, 0.2)`);
                innerGlow.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 80%, 0)`);

                ctx.fillStyle = innerGlow;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, innerGlowRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

                // LAYER 4: Main obstacle body with sophisticated lighting
                const bodyX = this.pos.x;
                const bodyY = this.pos.y + this.floatOffset;

                const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(
                    bodyX, bodyY,
                    bodyX + this.w, bodyY + this.h
                );

                const lightX = 0.2;
                const lightY = 0.2;
                const lightIntensity = 0.3 + Math.sin(this.innerGlowPhase) * 
0.1;

                bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, ${this.lightness * (1 + lightIntensity)}%)`);
                bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, ${this.lightness}%)`);
                bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, ${this.lightness * 0.7}%)`);

                let flashAmount = this.hitFlash;
                if (flashAmount > 0) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${flashAmount * 
0.3})`;
                    ctx.fillRect(bodyX - 5, bodyY - 5, this.w + 10, this.h + 
10);
                }

                ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
                ctx.shadowBlur = 25 + Math.sin(this.pulsePhase) * 10;
                ctx.shadowColor = this.glowColor;
                ctx.fillRect(bodyX, bodyY, this.w, this.h);
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                ctx.save();
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.rect(bodyX + 1, bodyY + 1, this.w - 2, this.h - 2);
                ctx.clip();

                const sheenGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(bodyX, bodyY, 
bodyX, bodyY + this.h);
                sheenGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)');
                sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.25, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)');
                sheenGrad.addColorStop(0.68, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)');
                sheenGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26)');
                ctx.fillStyle = sheenGrad;
                ctx.fillRect(bodyX, bodyY, this.w, this.h);

                this.surfacePanels.forEach((panel, index) => {
                    const panelGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(
                        bodyX + panel.x,
                        bodyY + panel.y,
                        bodyX + panel.x + panel.w,
                        bodyY + panel.y + panel.h
                    );
                    panelGrad.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${(this.colorHue + 10) % 
360}, ${this.saturation * 0.85}%, ${Math.min(92, this.lightness * 1.18)}%, 
${panel.alpha + 0.06})`);
                    panelGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${(this.colorHue - 12 + 
360) % 360}, ${this.saturation * 0.75}%, ${Math.max(18, this.lightness * 
0.6)}%, ${panel.alpha})`);
                    ctx.fillStyle = panelGrad;
                    ctx.fillRect(bodyX + panel.x, bodyY + panel.y, panel.w, 
panel.h);

                    ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation * 0.7}%, ${78 - index * 6}%, 0.28)`;
                    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                    ctx.strokeRect(bodyX + panel.x + 0.5, bodyY + panel.y + 
0.5, panel.w - 1, panel.h - 1);
                });

                ctx.lineWidth = 1;
                this.scanLineOffsets.forEach((offset, index) => {
                    const alpha = 0.06 + (index % 3) * 0.025;
                    ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation * 0.6}%, 92%, ${alpha})`;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(bodyX + 4, bodyY + offset);
                    ctx.lineTo(bodyX + this.w - 4, bodyY + offset);
                    ctx.stroke();
                });

                if (this.hazardBands.length && this.detailVariant % 2 === 0) {
                    ctx.save();
                    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2;
                    ctx.translate(bodyX + this.w * 0.14, bodyY + this.h * 
0.18);
                    ctx.rotate(-0.55);
                    this.hazardBands.forEach((band, index) => {
                        ctx.fillStyle = index % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(255, 214, 0, 
0.75)' : 'rgba(45, 8, 8, 0.5)';
                        ctx.fillRect(band.offset, 0, band.width, this.h * 
0.36);
                    });
                    ctx.restore();
                }

                ctx.restore();

                // LAYER 5: Edge lighting/bevel effect
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;

                const edgeGradTop = ctx.createLinearGradient(bodyX, bodyY, 
bodyX, bodyY + 8);
                edgeGradTop.addColorStop(0, this.edgeGlowTop);
                edgeGradTop.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');

                ctx.strokeStyle = edgeGradTop;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(bodyX, bodyY);
                ctx.lineTo(bodyX + this.w, bodyY);
                ctx.stroke();

                const edgeGradLeft = ctx.createLinearGradient(bodyX, bodyY, 
bodyX + 8, bodyY);
                edgeGradLeft.addColorStop(0, this.edgeGlowTop);
                edgeGradLeft.addColorStop(1, 'transparent');

                ctx.strokeStyle = edgeGradLeft;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(bodyX, bodyY);
                ctx.lineTo(bodyX, bodyY + this.h);
                ctx.stroke();

                ctx.save();
                this.rivetPoints.forEach((rivet, index) => {
                    const rivetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                        bodyX + rivet.x - 1,
                        bodyY + rivet.y - 1,
                        0,
                        bodyX + rivet.x,
                        bodyY + rivet.y,
                        4
                    );
                    rivetGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)');
                    rivetGrad.addColorStop(0.35, `hsla(${(this.colorHue + 18) 
% 360}, ${this.saturation * 0.6}%, 78%, 0.95)`);
                    rivetGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation * 0.75}%, 28%, 0.95)`);

                    ctx.fillStyle = rivetGrad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(bodyX + rivet.x, bodyY + rivet.y, 3.2, 0, Math.PI 
* 2);
                    ctx.fill();

                    if (index % 2 === 0) {
                        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28)';
                        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(bodyX + rivet.x - 1.6, bodyY + rivet.y);
                        ctx.lineTo(bodyX + rivet.x + 1.6, bodyY + rivet.y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                });
                ctx.restore();

                // LAYER 6: Inner patterns with glow
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
                ctx.strokeStyle = this.highlightColor;
                ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
                ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
                ctx.shadowColor = this.highlightColor;

                switch (this.patternType) {
                    case 0: // Energy grid
                        const gridSize = 18;
                        for (let x = 0; x <= this.w; x += gridSize) {
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(bodyX + x, bodyY);
                            ctx.lineTo(bodyX + x, bodyY + this.h);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                        for (let y = 0; y <= this.h; y += gridSize) {
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(bodyX, bodyY + y);
                            ctx.lineTo(bodyX + this.w, bodyY + y);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                        break;

                    case 1: // Concentric rings
                        const maxRing = Math.min(this.w, this.h) / 2 - 10;
                        for (let r = 10; r < maxRing; r += 15) {
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                        break;

                    case 2: // Radial lines
                        const lineCount = 12;
                        for (let i = 0; i < lineCount; i++) {
                            const angle = (i / lineCount) * Math.PI * 2 + 
this.pulsePhase;
                            const length = Math.min(this.w, this.h) / 2 - 5;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(centerX, centerY);
                            ctx.lineTo(
                                centerX + Math.cos(angle) * length,
                                centerY + Math.sin(angle) * length
                            );
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                        break;

                    case 3: // Circuit pattern
                        this.drawCircuitPattern(ctx, bodyX, bodyY, this.w, 
this.h);
                        break;

                    case 4: // Swirl pattern
                        this.drawSwirlPattern(ctx, centerX, centerY, 
Math.min(this.w, this.h) / 2 - 5);
                        break;
                }

                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                ctx.restore();



                // LAYER 8: Energy core
                const corePos = this.getCorePosition();

                const coreGlowRadius = 30 + Math.sin(this.pulsePhase * 3) * 5;
                const coreGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    corePos.x, corePos.y, 0,
                    corePos.x, corePos.y, coreGlowRadius
                );
                coreGlow.addColorStop(0, `hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.9)`);
                coreGlow.addColorStop(0.4, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 90%, 0.6)`);
                coreGlow.addColorStop(0.8, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 80%, 0.2)`);
                coreGlow.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 70%, 0)`);

                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                ctx.fillStyle = coreGlow;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(corePos.x, corePos.y, coreGlowRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                const coreSize = 8 + Math.sin(this.pulsePhase * 4) * 4;
                const coreInnerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                    corePos.x, corePos.y, 0,
                    corePos.x, corePos.y, coreSize
                );
                coreInnerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
                coreInnerGrad.addColorStop(0.3, `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 95%)`);
                coreInnerGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 80%)`);

                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
                ctx.fillStyle = coreInnerGrad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(corePos.x, corePos.y, coreSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(corePos.x - coreSize / 3, corePos.y - coreSize / 3, 
coreSize / 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // LAYER 9: Bloom layers (energy hotspots)
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                if (particleEffectsEnabled) {
                    this.bloomLayers.forEach(layer => {
                        ctx.globalAlpha = layer.alpha;
                        const bloomGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                            layer.x, layer.y, 0,
                            layer.x, layer.y, layer.radius
                        );
                        bloomGrad.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 100%, 0.8)`);
                        bloomGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 
${this.saturation}%, 90%, 0)`);

                        ctx.fillStyle = bloomGrad;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(layer.x, layer.y, layer.radius, 0, Math.PI * 
2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    });
                }
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

                // LAYER 10: Edge outline with subtle glow
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${this.colorHue}, ${this.saturation}%, 
90%, 0.6)`;
                ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
                ctx.shadowColor = `hsla(${this.colorHue}, ${this.saturation}%, 
90%, 0.4)`;
                ctx.strokeRect(bodyX, bodyY, this.w, this.h);
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

                ctx.restore();

                // LAYER 11: Shield burst effect
                if (this.showShieldBurst) {
                    ctx.save();
                    const burstAlpha = Math.min(1, this.shieldBurstTime * 3);
                    const ringCount = 3;

                    for (let i = 0; i < ringCount; i++) {
                        const ringRadius = this.shieldBurstRadius * (0.7 - i * 
0.2);
                        const ringAlpha = burstAlpha * (0.8 - i * 0.25);

                        const ringGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                            centerX, centerY, ringRadius * 0.9,
                            centerX, centerY, ringRadius
                        );
                        ringGrad.addColorStop(0, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 100%, 
100%, ${ringAlpha})`);
                        ringGrad.addColorStop(1, `hsla(${this.colorHue}, 100%, 
80%, 0)`);

                        ctx.globalAlpha = ringAlpha;
                        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                        ctx.fillStyle = ringGrad;
                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, ringRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                        ctx.fill();
                    }

                    ctx.restore();
                }

                this.hitParticles.forEach(p => p.render(ctx));
            }

            drawCircuitPattern(ctx, x, y, w, h) {
                this.circuitLinks.forEach(([startIndex, endIndex], linkIndex) 
=> {
                    const start = this.circuitNodes[startIndex];
                    const end = this.circuitNodes[endIndex];
                    if (!start || !end) return;

                    const startX = x + start.x;
                    const startY = y + start.y;
                    const endX = x + end.x;
                    const endY = y + end.y;
                    const midX = linkIndex % 2 === 0 ? startX : endX;

                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.moveTo(startX, startY);
                    ctx.lineTo(midX, startY);
                    ctx.lineTo(midX, endY);
                    ctx.lineTo(endX, endY);
                    ctx.stroke();
                });

                ctx.fillStyle = this.highlightColor;
                this.circuitNodes.forEach(node => {
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(x + node.x, y + node.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                });
            }

            drawSwirlPattern(ctx, cx, cy, radius) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                const segments = 50;
                for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
                    const t = i / segments;
                    const angle = t * Math.PI * 4 + this.pulsePhase;
                    const r = radius * (0.3 + 0.7 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI));
                    const x = cx + Math.cos(angle) * r;
                    const y = cy + Math.sin(angle) * r;

                    if (i === 0) {
                        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                    } else {
                        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
                    }
                }
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }
        

// ===================================================================
        // ZOMBIE BOSS - Performance Optimized with Advanced Lighting
        // + FULL BOSS FIRE WRAP UPGRADE + BIDIRECTIONAL FLOW + HEAT HAZE
        // ===================================================================

        class Vector2 {
            constructor(x = 0, y = 0) {
                this.x = x;
                this.y = y;
            }
            add(other) {
                return new Vector2(this.x + other.x, this.y + other.y);
            }
            subtract(other) {
                return new Vector2(this.x - other.x, this.y - other.y);
            }
            multiply(scalar) {
                return new Vector2(this.x * scalar, this.y * scalar);
            }
            magnitude() {
                return Math.sqrt(this.x * this.x + this.y * this.y);
            }
            normalize() {
                const mag = this.magnitude();
                return mag > 0 ? this.multiply(1 / mag) : new Vector2();
            }
            copy() {
                return new Vector2(this.x, this.y);
            }
        }

        // ===================================================================
        // SpriteFireRenderer - BI-DIRECTIONAL FLOW + MULTI-EMISSION + HEAT 
HAZE
        // ===================================================================
        class SpriteFireRenderer {
            constructor(options = {}) {
                this.fps = options.fps || 60;
                this.particles = [];
                // Further reduced count (20 is plenty with tails and sprites)
                this.maxParticles = 18; 
                this.lastSpawn = 0;
                this.particlePool = [];
                this.emissionPoints = [];
                this.emissionPointCount = 0;

                this.usePixi = false; // Force disabled for maximum 
performance 
                this.fallbackSprite = null;
                this.heatHazeSprite = null;

                // Heat haze - very few for performance
                this.heatHazeParticles = [];
                this.maxHazeParticles = 2; 
                this.hazeTime = 0;
            }

            isReady() { return true; }

            reset() {
                this.particles.length = 0;
                this.heatHazeParticles.length = 0;
                this.emissionPointCount = 0;
            }

            getEmissionPointSlot(index) {
                let point = this.emissionPoints[index];
                if (!point) {
                    point = { x: 0, y: 0, strength: 1, flow: 0 };
                    this.emissionPoints[index] = point;
                }
                return point;
            }

            getEmissionPoints(paddle, rageLevel) {
                const x = paddle.pos.x, y = paddle.pos.y, w = paddle.w, h = 
paddle.h;
                let count = 0;
                const write = (px, py, str, flow) => {
                    const p = this.getEmissionPointSlot(count++);
                    p.x = px; p.y = py; p.strength = str; p.flow = flow;
                };

                const rodW = w * 0.35;
                const rodX = x + (w - rodW) / 2;
                const rodTop = y - h * 1.32;

                // Main body points
                write(x + w * 0.5, y - 5, 1.2, 1);
                write(x + w * 0.5, y + h + 5, 1.0, -1);
                
                // Rod tip
                write(rodX + rodW * 0.5, rodTop, 1.0, 1);
                
                // Sparse rod climbing points
                const segments = 2 + Math.floor(rageLevel * 2);
                for (let i = 0; i < segments; i++) {
                    const py = rodTop + (y - rodTop) * (i / segments);
                    write(rodX, py, 0.7, 1);
                    write(rodX + rodW, py, 0.7, -1);
                }

                this.emissionPointCount = count;
                return count;
            }

            update(now, paddle, rageLevel) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) { this.reset(); return; }

                // Optimized Spawn Logic
                const spawnRate = 6 + rageLevel * 10;
                if (now - this.lastSpawn > 1000 / spawnRate) {
                    const pc = this.getEmissionPoints(paddle, rageLevel);
                    if (pc > 0) 
this.spawnParticle(this.emissionPoints[(Math.random() * pc) | 0], rageLevel);
                    this.lastSpawn = now;
                }

                const drag = 0.97;
                let wIdx = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < this.particles.length; i++) {
                    const p = this.particles[i];
                    p.life -= 0.018;
                    
                    // Simple sine drift instead of complex noise
                    p.vx += Math.sin(now * 0.005 + p.seed) * 0.15;
                    p.vy += p.flowDir * 0.2;
                    p.vx *= drag; p.vy *= drag;
                    p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
                    p.size *= 0.985;

                    // Small history for trail
                    if (!p.h) p.h = [];
                    p.h.push({x: p.x, y: p.y});
                    if (p.h.length > 3) p.h.shift();

                    if (p.life > 0 && p.size > 1.5) {
                        this.particles[wIdx++] = p;
                    } else if (this.particlePool.length < this.maxParticles) {
                        this.particlePool.push(p);
                    }
                }
                this.particles.length = wIdx;
                this.updateHeatHaze(now, paddle, rageLevel);
            }

            spawnParticle(em, rageLevel) {
                let p = this.particlePool.length ? this.particlePool.pop() : 
(this.particles.length < this.maxParticles ? {} : null);
                if (!p) return;
                p.x = em.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
                p.y = em.y;
                p.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5;
                p.vy = em.flow * (1.2 + Math.random());
                p.size = 6 + Math.random() * 8 + rageLevel * 10;
                p.life = 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8;
                p.seed = Math.random() * 100;
                p.flowDir = em.flow;
                p.strength = em.strength;
                p.h = [];
                this.particles.push(p);
            }

            updateHeatHaze(now, paddle, rageLevel) {
                if (rageLevel < 0.2 || Math.random() > 0.1) return;
                if (this.heatHazeParticles.length < this.maxHazeParticles) {
                    this.heatHazeParticles.push({
                        x: paddle.pos.x + Math.random() * paddle.w,
                        y: paddle.pos.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * paddle.h,
                        size: 40 + Math.random() * 40,
                        life: 1.0
                    });
                }
                let wIdx = 0;
                for (let h of this.heatHazeParticles) {
                    h.life -= 0.02; h.y -= 0.5;
                    if (h.life > 0) this.heatHazeParticles[wIdx++] = h;
                }
                this.heatHazeParticles.length = wIdx;
            }

            render(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) return false;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
                
                this.renderHeatHaze(ctx, rageLevel);
                this.renderFullAura(ctx, paddle, rageLevel);
                this.renderWrappingCore(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now);
                this.renderRodClimbingFlames(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now);
                this.renderCanvasParticles(ctx, now);

                ctx.restore();
                return true;
            }

            renderHeatHaze(ctx, rageLevel) {
                if (!this.heatHazeParticles.length) return;
                this.ensureHeatHazeSprite();
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 * rageLevel;
                for (const h of this.heatHazeParticles) {
                    const s = h.size * (0.8 + h.life * 0.2);
                    ctx.drawImage(this.heatHazeSprite, h.x - s/2, h.y - s/2, 
s, s);
                }
            }

            renderFullAura(ctx, paddle, rageLevel) {
                if (rageLevel < 0.3) return;
                const cx = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w/2, cy = paddle.pos.y + 
paddle.h/2;
                const r = 80 + rageLevel * 60;
                const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, r);
                g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 120, 0, ${0.2 * rageLevel})`);
                g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 40, 0, 0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = g;
                ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r*2, r*2);
            }

            renderWrappingCore(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                const cx = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w/2, by = paddle.pos.y;
                const h = 40 + rageLevel * 100, w = paddle.w * (1.1 + 
rageLevel);
                const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, by - h*0.3, 0, cx, by - 
h*0.3, w*0.8);
                g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 230, 150, 0.7)');
                g.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255, 80, 0, 0.3)');
                g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0)');
                ctx.fillStyle = g;
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, by - h*0.3, w*0.5, h*0.8, 0, 
0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
            }

            renderRodClimbingFlames(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                const rodW = paddle.w * 0.35, rodX = paddle.pos.x + (paddle.w 
- rodW)/2;
                const rodTop = paddle.pos.y - paddle.h * 1.32, rodBottom = 
paddle.pos.y;
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 50, 0.5)';
                ctx.lineWidth = 3 + rageLevel * 3;
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rodX + rodW/2, rodBottom); 
ctx.lineTo(rodX + rodW/2, rodTop); ctx.stroke();
                
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 100, 0, 0.4)';
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    const th = 30 + Math.sin(now * 0.01 + i) * 15;
                    ctx.fillRect(rodX + rodW * (i/2) - 2, rodTop - th/2, 4, 
th);
                }
            }

            ensureFallbackSprite() {
                if (this.fallbackSprite) return;
                const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 32; 
c.height = 32;
                const g = c.getContext('2d');
                const gra = g.createRadialGradient(16, 16, 0, 16, 16, 16);
                gra.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gra.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 
210, 50, 0.9)'); gra.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 40, 0, 0)');
                g.fillStyle = gra; g.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 32);
                this.fallbackSprite = c;
            }

            ensureHeatHazeSprite() {
                if (this.heatHazeSprite) return;
                const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; 
c.height = 64;
                const g = c.getContext('2d');
                const gra = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
                gra.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 140, 40, 0.4)'); 
gra.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
                g.fillStyle = gra; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
                this.heatHazeSprite = c;
            }

            renderCanvasParticles(ctx, now) {
                this.ensureFallbackSprite();
                for (let i = 0; i < this.particles.length; i++) {
                    const p = this.particles[i];
                    const a = p.life * 0.8; ctx.globalAlpha = a;
                    if (p.h && p.h.length > 1) {
                        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 180, 50, ${a * 0.4})`;
                        ctx.lineWidth = p.size * 0.4;
                        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p.h[0].x, p.h[0].y);
                        for (let j = 1; j < p.h.length; j++) 
ctx.lineTo(p.h[j].x, p.h[j].y);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                    ctx.drawImage(this.fallbackSprite, p.x - p.size/2, p.y - 
p.size/2, p.size, p.size);
                }
            }

            renderWrappingParticles(ctx, rageLevel, now) {
                this.renderCanvasParticles(ctx, now);
            }

            initPixi() {}
            resizePixiIfNeeded() {}
            renderPixiParticles() {}
        }

            update(now, paddle, rageLevel) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) {
                    this.reset();
                    return;
                }

                // drastically reduced spawn rate for low-end performance
                const spawnRate = 2 + rageLevel * 6;
                if (now - this.lastSpawn > 1000 / spawnRate) {
                    const pointCount = this.getEmissionPoints(paddle, 
rageLevel);
                    const spawnsThisFrame = 1; // keep per-frame spawns minimal
                    if (pointCount > 0) {
                        const idx = (Math.random() * pointCount) | 0;
                        this.spawnParticle(this.emissionPoints[idx], paddle, 
rageLevel);
                    }
                    this.lastSpawn = now;
                }

                const centerX = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w * 0.5;
                const centerY = paddle.pos.y + paddle.h * 0.5;
                // reduce force/drag a little to calm particles
                const radialForce   = 0.05 + rageLevel * 0.09;
                const tangentialForce = 0.018 + rageLevel * 0.032;
                const drag = 0.986 - rageLevel * 0.008;

                const baseNoiseTime = now * 0.004;
                const noiseAmp = 0.3 + rageLevel * 0.45;

                let writeIndex = 0;
                for (let readIndex = 0; readIndex < this.particles.length; 
readIndex++) {
                    const p = this.particles[readIndex];
                    p.life -= 0.018;
                    if (p.seed === undefined) p.seed = Math.random() * 1600;

                    const dx = p.x - centerX;
                    const dy = p.y - centerY;
                    const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                    const invDist = distSq > 1 ? 1 / Math.sqrt(distSq) : 1;
                    const nx = dx * invDist;
                    const ny = dy * invDist;
                    const tx = -ny;
                    const ty = nx;

                    const randVal = (p.rand !== undefined) ? p.rand : (p.rand 
= Math.random());
                    const flowBias = p.flowDir * (0.9 + randVal * 0.3);
                    const noise = Math.sin(baseNoiseTime + p.seed) * noiseAmp;

                    p.vx += nx * radialForce * flowBias + tx * tangentialForce 
* p.spinDir + noise * 0.14;
                    p.vy += ny * radialForce * flowBias + ty * tangentialForce 
* p.spinDir + noise * 0.08;

                    p.vy += p.flowDir * (0.018 + rageLevel * 0.028);

                    p.vx *= drag;
                    p.vy *= drag;
                    p.x += p.vx;
                    p.y += p.vy;
                    p.size *= 0.98;

                    if (p.life <= 0 || p.size < 1.1) {
                        // recycle to pool
                        if (this.particlePool.length < this.maxParticles) {
                            this.particlePool.push(p);
                        }
                    } else {
                        this.particles[writeIndex++] = p;
                    }
                }
                this.particles.length = writeIndex;

                this.updateHeatHaze(now, paddle, rageLevel);

                if (this.particles.length > this.maxParticles) {
                    const overflow = this.particles.length - this.maxParticles;
                    for (let i = 0; i < overflow; i++) {
                        const p = this.particles[i];
                        if (this.particlePool.length < this.maxParticles) {
                            this.particlePool.push(p);
                        }
                    }
                    this.particles.copyWithin(0, overflow, 
this.particles.length);
                    this.particles.length = this.maxParticles;
                }
            }

            spawnParticle(emission, paddle, rageLevel) {
                const spread = paddle.w * 0.4;
                const centerX = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w * 0.5;
                const centerY = paddle.pos.y + paddle.h * 0.5;
                const spawnX = emission.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * spread;
                const spawnY = emission.y;

                let baseAngle = Math.atan2(spawnY - centerY, spawnX - centerX);

                const flowDir = emission.flow;
                if (flowDir === 1) {
                    baseAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
                } else if (flowDir === -1) {
                    baseAngle = Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
                } else {
                    baseAngle += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4;
                }

                const speed = 1.3 + Math.random() * (2.0 + rageLevel * 3.0);

                // reuse from pool if available
                let particle;
                if (this.particlePool.length) {
                    particle = this.particlePool.pop();
                } else if (this.particles.length < this.maxParticles) {
                    particle = {};
                }
                if (!particle) return; // reached capacity

                particle.x = spawnX;
                particle.y = spawnY;
                particle.size = 6 + Math.random() * 12 + rageLevel * 10;
                particle.vx = Math.cos(baseAngle) * speed;
                particle.vy = Math.sin(baseAngle) * speed;
                particle.life = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.9;
                particle.seed = Math.random() * 1600;
                particle.rand = Math.random();
                particle.strength = emission.strength || 1;
                particle.radialBias = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.6;
                particle.spinDir = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
                particle.flowDir = flowDir;
                this.particles.push(particle);
            }

            updateHeatHaze(now, paddle, rageLevel) {
                this.hazeTime += 0.016;
                const spawnRate = 4 + rageLevel * 6; // drastically reduced
                if (now % (1000 / spawnRate) < 12) {
                    this.spawnHeatHaze(paddle, rageLevel);
                }

                let writeIndex = 0;
                for (let readIndex = 0; readIndex < 
this.heatHazeParticles.length; readIndex++) {
                    const h = this.heatHazeParticles[readIndex];
                    h.life -= 0.012;
                    h.x += Math.sin(this.hazeTime * 2.3 + h.seed) * 0.8;
                    h.y += Math.sin(this.hazeTime * 1.7 + h.seed * 1.3) * 0.6;
                    h.distort += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
                    h.size *= 1.008;

                    if (h.life > 0) {
                        this.heatHazeParticles[writeIndex++] = h;
                    }
                }
                this.heatHazeParticles.length = writeIndex;

                if (this.heatHazeParticles.length > this.maxHazeParticles) {
                    const removeCount = Math.min(4, 
this.heatHazeParticles.length);
                    this.heatHazeParticles.copyWithin(0, removeCount, 
this.heatHazeParticles.length);
                    this.heatHazeParticles.length -= removeCount;
                }
            }

            spawnHeatHaze(paddle, rageLevel) {
                const cx = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w * 0.5;
                const cy = paddle.pos.y + paddle.h * 0.5;
                this.heatHazeParticles.push({
                    x: cx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * paddle.w * 1.6,
                    y: cy + (Math.random() - 0.5) * paddle.h * 1.4,
                    size: 24 + Math.random() * 32,
                    life: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8,
                    seed: Math.random() * 2000,
                    distort: 0,
                    intensity: 0.4 + rageLevel * 0.6
                });
            }

            render(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) {
                    return false;
                }

                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';

                this.renderHeatHaze(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now);
                this.renderFullAura(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now);
                this.renderWrappingCore(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now);
                this.renderRodClimbingFlames(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now);
                this.renderWrappingParticles(ctx, rageLevel, now);

                ctx.restore();
                return true;
            }

            renderHeatHaze(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                if (rageLevel < 0.1) return;

                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
                ctx.globalAlpha = 0.10 + rageLevel * 0.18;
                ctx.filter = 'blur(1px) brightness(1.3)';
                this.ensureHeatHazeSprite();
                const hazeSprite = this.heatHazeSprite;

                for (const h of this.heatHazeParticles) {
                    const alpha = h.life * h.intensity * (0.7 + Math.sin(now * 
0.023 + h.seed) * 0.3);
                    const drawAlpha = alpha * 0.7;
                    if (drawAlpha <= 0.001) continue;
                    ctx.globalAlpha = drawAlpha;

                    const distortX = Math.sin(now * 0.009 + h.seed) * 
h.distort * 2;
                    const distortY = Math.cos(now * 0.007 + h.seed * 1.4) * 
h.distort * 1.5;
                    const drawX = h.x + distortX;
                    const drawY = h.y + distortY;
                    const radius = h.size * 0.9;
                    const diameter = radius * 2;

                    if (hazeSprite) {
                        ctx.drawImage(hazeSprite, drawX - radius, drawY - 
radius, diameter, diameter);
                        continue;
                    }

                    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
                        drawX, drawY, 0,
                        drawX, drawY, h.size
                    );
                    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 140, 40, 0.9)');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 80, 20, 0.6)');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 20, 0, 0)');

                    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(drawX, drawY, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fill();
                }

                ctx.filter = 'none';
                ctx.restore();
            }

            renderFullAura(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                if (rageLevel < 0.15) return;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
                ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0.12, rageLevel * 0.28);

                const cx = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w / 2;
                const cy = paddle.pos.y + paddle.h / 2;
                const radius = Math.max(paddle.w, paddle.h) * 1.15 + rageLevel 
* 50;

                const aura = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, paddle.w * 0.35, 
cx, cy - 20, radius);
                aura.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 210, 90, 0.5)');
                aura.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255, 95, 25, 0.32)');
                aura.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 30, 0, 0)');

                ctx.fillStyle = aura;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - 10, radius * 0.85, radius * 0.72, 0, 0, 
Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.restore();
            }

            renderWrappingCore(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                const cx = paddle.pos.x + paddle.w / 2;
                const by = paddle.pos.y;
                const flicker = Math.sin(now * 0.009) * 4.5 + Math.sin(now * 
0.021) * 6.5;
                const h = 52 + rageLevel * 135;
                const w = paddle.w * (1.08 + rageLevel * 1.35);

                // Cache gradient to avoid reallocating every frame when size 
doesn't change significantly.
                const cacheKey = 
`${Math.round(w)}|${Math.round(h)}|${Math.round(rageLevel*100)}`;
                if (!this._wrapGradientCache || this._wrapGradientCache.key 
!== cacheKey) {
                    this._wrapGradientCache = { key: cacheKey };
                    const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, by - h * 0.28, 
15, cx, by - h * 0.22, w * 1.1);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,235,0.99)');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(255,215,85,0.94)');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.48, 'rgba(255,125,25,0.85)');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.78, 'rgba(255,40,0,0.38)');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200,0,0,0)');
                    this._wrapGradientCache.grad = grad;
                }

                ctx.fillStyle = this._wrapGradientCache.grad;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.ellipse(cx, by - h * 0.35 + flicker * 0.4, w * 0.48, h * 
0.82, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
            }

            renderRodClimbingFlames(ctx, paddle, rageLevel, now) {
                const rodW = paddle.w * 0.35;
                const rodX = paddle.pos.x + (paddle.w - rodW) / 2;
                const rodTop = paddle.pos.y - paddle.h * 1.32;

                ctx.shadowBlur = 36 + rageLevel * 28;
                ctx.shadowColor = '#ff7700';
                ctx.lineWidth = 10.5 + rageLevel * 9;
                ctx.lineCap = 'round';

                // Use a single stroke style instead of creating a gradient 
every iteration
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 140, 30, 0.82)';

                const flameCount = 4 + Math.floor(rageLevel * 2.5);
                const baseY = paddle.pos.y;

                for (let side = -1; side <= 1; side += 2) {
                    const startX = rodX + (side > 0 ? rodW : 0) + side * 2;
                    for (let i = 0; i < flameCount; i++) {
                        const sway = Math.sin(now * 0.008 + i * 1.9) * (13 + 
rageLevel * 22);
                        const height = 42 + rageLevel * 75 + i * 15;

                        ctx.beginPath();
                        ctx.moveTo(startX, baseY - 6);
                        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(startX + sway * 0.3, baseY - 
height * 0.45, startX + sway, rodTop + i * 20);
                        ctx.stroke();
                    }
                }
            }

            ensureFallbackParticleSprite() {
                if (this.fallbackSprite) return;
                const size = 64;
                const c = document.createElement('canvas');
                c.width = size;
                c.height = size;
                const g = c.getContext('2d');
                const grad = g.createRadialGradient(size * 0.5, size * 0.5, 1, 
size * 0.5, size * 0.5, size * 0.5);
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,248,190,1)');
                grad.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(255,155,35,0.8)');
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,15,0,0)');
                g.fillStyle = grad;
                g.beginPath();
                g.arc(size * 0.5, size * 0.5, size * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                g.fill();
                this.fallbackSprite = c;
            }

            ensureHeatHazeSprite() {
                if (this.heatHazeSprite) return;
                const size = this.heatHazeSpriteSize;
                const c = document.createElement('canvas');
                c.width = size;
                c.height = size;
                const g = c.getContext('2d');
                const half = size * 0.5;
                const grad = g.createRadialGradient(half, half, 0, half, half, 
half);
                // Keep the exact heat-haze palette used by the original 
per-particle gradient path.
                grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 140, 40, 0.9)');
                grad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255, 80, 20, 0.6)');
                grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 20, 0, 0)');
                g.fillStyle = grad;
                g.beginPath();
                g.arc(half, half, half, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                g.fill();
                this.heatHazeSprite = c;
            }

            initPixi(ctx) {
                if (!this.usePixi || this.pixiApp || this.pixiInitFailed) 
return;

                try {
                    const PIXI = window.PIXI;
                    this.pixiApp = new PIXI.Application({
                        width: ctx.canvas.width,
                        height: ctx.canvas.height,
                        antialias: false,
                        autoStart: false,
                        backgroundAlpha: 0,
                        clearBeforeRender: true,
                        preserveDrawingBuffer: false,
                        powerPreference: 'high-performance',
                        resolution: 1
                    });

                    this.pixiCanvas = this.pixiApp.view;
                    this.pixiContainer = new 
PIXI.ParticleContainer(this.maxParticles, {
                        position: true,
                        scale: true,
                        alpha: true,
                        tint: true
                    });
                    this.pixiApp.stage.addChild(this.pixiContainer);

                    const texCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                    texCanvas.width = 64;
                    texCanvas.height = 64;
                    const tctx = texCanvas.getContext('2d');
                    const grad = tctx.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 1, 32, 32, 
32);
                    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
                    grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,185,80,0.82)');
                    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,40,0,0)');
                    tctx.fillStyle = grad;
                    tctx.beginPath();
                    tctx.arc(32, 32, 32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    tctx.fill();

                    this.particleTexture = PIXI.Texture.from(texCanvas);

                    for (let i = 0; i < this.maxParticles; i++) {
                        const s = new PIXI.Sprite(this.particleTexture);
                        s.anchor.set(0.5);
                        s.visible = false;
                        this.pixiContainer.addChild(s);
                        this.pixiSprites.push(s);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    this.pixiInitFailed = true;
                    this.usePixi = false;
                    this.pixiApp = null;
                    this.pixiCanvas = null;
                    this.pixiContainer = null;
                    this.pixiSprites.length = 0;
                }
            }

            resizePixiIfNeeded(ctx) {
                if (!this.pixiApp) return;
                if (this.pixiApp.renderer.width !== ctx.canvas.width || 
this.pixiApp.renderer.height !== ctx.canvas.height) {
                    this.pixiApp.renderer.resize(ctx.canvas.width, 
ctx.canvas.height);
                }
            }

            renderPixiParticles(ctx, rageLevel, now) {
                const flicker = 0.7 + Math.sin(now * 0.042) * 0.3;
                const tint = rageLevel > 0.55 ? 0xff6a00 : 0xffdc6d;

                for (let i = 0; i < this.maxParticles; i++) {
                    const sprite = this.pixiSprites[i];
                    const p = this.particles[i];
                    if (!p) {
                        sprite.visible = false;
                        continue;
                    }

                    const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life * p.strength 
* flicker * 0.95));
                    const scale = Math.max(0.02, (p.size * 2) / 64);

                    sprite.visible = true;
                    sprite.x = p.x;
                    sprite.y = p.y;
                    sprite.scale.set(scale);
                    sprite.alpha = alpha;
                    sprite.tint = tint;
                }

                this.pixiApp.renderer.render(this.pixiApp.stage);
                ctx.drawImage(this.pixiCanvas, 0, 0);
            }

            renderCanvasParticles(ctx, now) {
                this.ensureFallbackParticleSprite();
                const t = now * 0.012;
                const flicker = 0.7 + Math.sin(t * 3.5) * 0.3;

                for (let i = 0; i < this.particles.length; i++) {
                    const p = this.particles[i];
                    const alpha = p.life * p.strength * flicker * 0.95;
                    const drawSize = p.size * 2;
                    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
                    ctx.drawImage(this.fallbackSprite, p.x - drawSize * 0.5, 
p.y - drawSize * 0.5, drawSize, drawSize);
                }
            }

            renderWrappingParticles(ctx, rageLevel, now) {
                this.initPixi(ctx);
                if (this.pixiApp) {
                    this.resizePixiIfNeeded(ctx);
                    this.renderPixiParticles(ctx, rageLevel, now);
                    return;
                }
                this.renderCanvasParticles(ctx, now);
            }
        }

        // ===================================================================
        // ZombieBoss
        // ===================================================================
        class ZombieBoss {
            constructor(paddle, ball, game) {
                this.paddle = paddle;
                this.ball = ball;
                this.game = game;

                // multiplayer indicator – when true, boss abilities 
(including the
                // canvas‑darkening curse) are completely disabled.
                this.isPvP = !!(game && game.isMultiplayer);

                // In PvP we keep a plain-looking right paddle — no boss skin, 
no effects.
                if (this.isPvP) {
                    // do NOT apply zombie skin; the paddle renders as a 
regular player paddle
                    return;
                }

                // mark the paddle as belonging to the ZombieBoss and adjust 
colours
                if (this.paddle && typeof this.paddle.setZombieBossSkin === 
'function') {
                    this.paddle.setZombieBossSkin(true);
                } else if (this.paddle) {
                    this.paddle.isZombieBoss = true;
                    this.paddle.primaryColor = '#66ff66';
                    this.paddle.secondaryColor = 
this.paddle._adjustColor('#66ff66', 1.5);
                    this.paddle.accentColor = 
this.paddle._adjustColor('#66ff66', 0.7);
                    this.paddle.color = this.paddle.primaryColor;
                }

                this.originalPaddleWidth = paddle.w;
                this.originalPaddleHeight = paddle.h;

                this.targetPaddleWidth = this.originalPaddleWidth;
                this.paddleRecoverySpeed = 80;
                this.paddleRecoveryDelay = 1.2;
                this.recoveryTimer = 0;

                this.aiController = new AIController(paddle, ball, game.width, 
game.height, 3);
                this.aiController.voice = null;

                this.particlePool = [];
                this.activeParticles = [];
                this.maxFireParticles = 9;
                this.smokePool = [];
                this.activeSmoke = [];
                this.maxSmokeParticles = 5;

                this.fireIntensity = 1.0;
                this.rageLevel = 0;
                this.phase = 1;

                this.ambientLight = 0;
                this.lightRadius = 80;
                this.screenDarkness = 0;

                this.maxHealth = 110;
                this.health = this.maxHealth;
                this.lastPlayerScore = 0;

                this.fireTongues = [];
                this.mainFlames = [];
                this.fireBreathActive = false;
                this.fireBreathDuration = 0;
                this.fireBreathCooldown = 0;

                this.screenShake = 0;
                this.screenShakeIntensity = 0;

                this.canvasCurseActive = false;
                this.canvasCurseTimer = 0;
                this.canvasCurseCooldown = 3.2;
                this.canvasCurseStrength = 0;
                this.canvasCurseTarget = 0;
                this.activeCurseStrength = 0;

                this.particleUpdateCounter = 0;
                this.particleUpdateInterval = 3;
                this.time = 0;

                this.rodBaseColor = '#ff3300';
                this.rodGlowColor = '#ffaa00';
                this.neonColors = ['#ff3300', '#ff6600', '#ffaa00', '#ffff00', 
'#ffffff', '#ff00aa'];

                this.spriteFire = new SpriteFireRenderer({
                    fps: 48,
                    maxParticles: 180,
                    maxHazeParticles: 30
                });

                this._fireTongueStride = 12;
                this._fireTongueWasmBuffer = null;
                this._fireTongueWasmCapacity = 0;

                // only initialise the heavy fire/smoke systems when we're 
acting as a
                // true boss; PvP players should appear lit but shouldn't 
generate clouds
                // of particles or breathing flames.
                if (!this.isPvP) {
                    this.initializeFireSystem();
                    this.initializeSmokeSystem();
                    this.initializeMainFlames();
                }
            }

            getPaddleCenter() {
                return new Vector2(
                    this.paddle.pos.x + this.paddle.w / 2,
                    this.paddle.pos.y + this.paddle.h / 2
                );
            }

            getPaddleTopCenter() {
                return new Vector2(
                    this.paddle.pos.x + this.paddle.w / 2,
                    this.paddle.pos.y
                );
            }

            rotateVector(v, angle) {
                const cos = Math.cos(angle);
                const sin = Math.sin(angle);
                return new Vector2(
                    v.x * cos - v.y * sin,
                    v.x * sin + v.y * cos
                );
            }

            shrinkPaddle(newWidth) {
                newWidth = Math.max(20, Math.min(this.originalPaddleWidth * 
0.35, newWidth));
                this.paddle.w = newWidth;
                this.targetPaddleWidth = newWidth;
                this.recoveryTimer = this.paddleRecoveryDelay;
            }

            resetPaddleSize() {
                this.paddle.w = this.originalPaddleWidth;
                this.targetPaddleWidth = this.originalPaddleWidth;
                this.recoveryTimer = 0;
            }

            initializeFireSystem() {
                for (let i = 0; i < this.maxFireParticles; i++) {
                    this.particlePool.push(this.createParticle());
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < this.maxFireParticles * 0.6; i++) {
                    this.activateParticle(true);
                }
            }

            initializeSmokeSystem() {
                for (let i = 0; i < this.maxSmokeParticles; i++) {
                    this.smokePool.push(this.createSmokeParticle());
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < this.maxSmokeParticles * 0.5; i++) {
                    this.activateSmokeParticle(true);
                }
            }

            initializeMainFlames() {
                this.mainFlames = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    this.mainFlames.push(this.createMainFlame());
                }
            }

            createParticle() {
                return {
                    position: new Vector2(),
                    velocity: new Vector2(),
                    size: 5 + Math.random() * 10,
                    life: 0,
                    maxLife: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8,
                    temperature: 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3,
                    active: false,
                    rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                    rotationSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15,
                    colorIndex: Math.floor(Math.random() * 
this.neonColors.length)
                };
            }

            createSmokeParticle() {
                return {
                    position: new Vector2(),
                    velocity: new Vector2((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8, -0.6 - 
Math.random() * 0.8),
                    size: 12 + Math.random() * 12,
                    life: 0,
                    maxLife: 2.0 + Math.random() * 1.0,
                    alpha: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.25,
                    active: false,
                    rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                    rotationSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08
                };
            }

            createMainFlame() {
                return {
                    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                    swayPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                    length: 90 + Math.random() * 50,
                    baseWidth: this.paddle.w * (0.65 + Math.random() * 0.5),
                    colorShift: Math.random() * 60,
                    intensity: 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.45
                };
            }

            activateParticle(initial = false) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) return;
                const particle = this.particlePool.find(p => !p.active);
                if (!particle) return;
                const center = this.getPaddleTopCenter();
                const spread = this.paddle.w * 1.0;
                particle.position = center.add(
                    new Vector2((Math.random() - 0.5) * spread, initial ? 
Math.random() * 15 : 0)
                );
                const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                const speed = Math.random() * 3.5 + 1.5;
                particle.velocity = new Vector2(
                    Math.cos(angle) * speed,
                    Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3.5
                );
                particle.size = Math.random() * 5 + 3;
                particle.life = Math.random() * 0.9 + 0.4;
                particle.maxLife = 0.9;
                particle.temperature = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.75;
                particle.active = true;
                particle.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                particle.rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
                particle.colorIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 
this.neonColors.length);
                this.activeParticles.push(particle);
            }

            activateSmokeParticle(initial = false) {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) return;
                const smoke = this.smokePool.find(p => !p.active);
                if (!smoke) return;
                const center = this.getPaddleTopCenter();
                const spread = this.paddle.w * 0.8;
                smoke.position = center.add(
                    new Vector2((Math.random() - 0.5) * spread, initial ? 
Math.random() * 15 : -8)
                );
                const angle = -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.PI / 
4;
                const speed = Math.random() * 0.8 + 0.4;
                smoke.velocity = new Vector2(
                    Math.cos(angle) * speed,
                    Math.sin(angle) * speed
                );
                smoke.size = Math.random() * 10 + 10;
                smoke.life = Math.random() * 1.2 + 0.8;
                smoke.maxLife = 2.2;
                smoke.alpha = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3;
                smoke.active = true;
                smoke.rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                smoke.rotationSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.08;
                this.activeSmoke.push(smoke);
            }

            createFireTongue() {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) return;
                if (this.rageLevel < 0.25) return;
                const center = this.getPaddleTopCenter();
                const angle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * Math.PI * 0.8;
                const speed = 18 + Math.random() * 32 * this.rageLevel;
                const tongue = {
                    position: center.copy(),
                    velocity: new Vector2(Math.cos(angle), 
Math.sin(angle)).multiply(speed)
                        .add(new Vector2(0, -45 - this.rageLevel * 80)),
                    height: 12 + Math.random() * 20 * this.rageLevel,
                    width: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
                    life: 0.7 + Math.random() * 1.0,
                    maxLife: 1.6,
                    swayAmount: Math.random() * 10,
                    swaySpeed: Math.random() * 0.15 + 0.08,
                    phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
                    colorIndex: Math.floor(Math.random() * 
this.neonColors.length)
                };
                this.fireTongues.push(tongue);
            }

            createFireBreath() {
                if (!areParticleEffectsEnabled()) return;
                if (this.fireBreathCooldown > 0 || this.rageLevel <= 0) return;
                this.fireBreathActive = true;
                this.fireBreathDuration = 1.2 + this.rageLevel * 0.8;
                this.fireBreathCooldown = 5 - this.rageLevel * 3;
                const origin = this.getPaddleTopCenter();
                const forward = new Vector2(0, -1);
                for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                    const particle = this.particlePool.find(p => !p.active);
                    if (!particle) break;
                    const spreadAngle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * (Math.PI / 
2.5);
                    const direction = this.rotateVector(forward, spreadAngle);
                    const speed = Math.random() * 10 + 5;
                    particle.position = origin.copy();
                    particle.velocity = direction.multiply(speed);
                    particle.size = Math.random() * 12 + 6;
                    particle.life = 1.0;
                    particle.maxLife = 1.2;
                    particle.temperature = 1.0;
                    particle.active = true;
                    particle.colorIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 
this.neonColors.length);
                    this.activeParticles.push(particle);
                }
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                    this.activateSmokeParticle();
                }
                this.screenShake = 0.3;
                this.screenShakeIntensity = 7 + 5 * this.rageLevel;
            }

            clearParticleEffects() {
                this.particlePool.forEach(particle => {
                    particle.active = false;
                    particle.life = 0;
                });
                this.smokePool.forEach(smoke => {
                    smoke.active = false;
                    smoke.life = 0;
                    smoke.alpha = 0;
                });

                this.activeParticles = [];
                this.activeSmoke = [];
                this.fireTongues = [];
                this.mainFlames = [];
                this.fireBreathActive = false;
                this.fireBreathDuration = 0;
                this.spriteFire.reset();
            }

            shouldRenderHeavyPass(passName) {
                switch (passName) {
                    case 'ambient':
                        return this.rageLevel > 0.08;
                    case 'bleed':
                        return this.phase >= 2;
                    case 'rays':
                        return this.fireBreathActive || (this.phase >= 3 && 
this.rageLevel > 0.7);
                    case 'distortion':
                        return this.fireBreathActive && this.rageLevel > 0.45;
                    case 'bloom':
                        return this.fireBreathActive || (this.phase >= 3 && 
this.rageLevel > 0.74);
                    default:
                        return true;
                }
            }

            triggerCanvasCurse(multiplier = 1) {
                if (!this.game?.canvas) return;
                if (this.game?.isMultiplayer) return; // never trigger in PvP

                const strength = Math.min(0.62, (0.24 + this.rageLevel * 0.28) 
* multiplier);
                this.canvasCurseActive = true;
                // fixed duration so effect always lasts 5 seconds when invoked
                this.canvasCurseTimer = 5;
                this.canvasCurseCooldown = Math.max(2.6, 6.2 - this.rageLevel 
* 2.5);
                this.canvasCurseTarget = Math.max(this.canvasCurseTarget, 
strength);
                this.screenShake = Math.max(this.screenShake, 0.12 + 
this.rageLevel * 0.08);
                this.screenShakeIntensity = 
Math.max(this.screenShakeIntensity, 4 + this.rageLevel * 4);
            }

            updateCanvasCurse(dt) {
